claims: Within the statically recovered 001ce288 loop, each iteration calls 00128ca0 before 001288b0; 001288b0 emits geometry through 00128e88, whose tail appends STMOD immediate 0 and STCYCL immediate 0x0404 before the next visible loop iteration.

The 00128ca0 VIF command 0x6c080000 is an eight-element V4-32 UNPACK with immediate address zero and no mask bit; if the preceding VIF state remains in STMOD 0 and STCYCL 4/4, the pinned PCSX2 implementation treats every component as data and takes the full write path, consistent with unchanged word values for this packet.

uGpffff9218 selects the 00128e88 header destination between 0x208 and 0x2c8, while uGpffff921c selects tail BASE 0x3aa or 0x388; 00128e88 toggles both, and initialization clears both, but other functions also write these globals so this is not a global invariant.

evidence.text: 001ce288.c: within its do loop, after FUN_00126c18(4) returns nonzero, it calls FUN_00128ca0(auStack_c0), then computes values and calls FUN_001288b0(...), then increments iVar7 and loops. The static direct-callee closure contains 276 functions.

00128ca0.c calls FUN_0010fa70(0,0,0,0), FUN_0010f8f8(), FUN_0010fa20(0x14,0), then stores 0x6c080000 and copies eight 16-byte chunks from param_1 at byte offsets 0,16,32,48,64,80,96,112 into the packet before finalizing its CNT tag.

001288b0.c calls FUN_00128e88 for each record. 00128e88.c appends 0x05000000 (STMOD immediate 0), then 0x01000404 (STCYCL, encoded CL=4 WL=4), then 0x17000000 (MSCNT), selects BASE 0x030003aa if uGpffff921c==0 else 0x03000388, and toggles both uGpffff921c and uGpffff9218.

Pinned PCSX2 commit 81526d4, Vif_Unpack.cpp lines 22-58: writeXYZW initializes mask selector n=0 unless doMask; for selector 0 and mode other than 1,2,3, the default branch assigns dest=data. Lines 221-231 calculate unpack size; with WL=4 and CL=4, WL<=CL selects the full-size path. Lines 233-235 only add TOPS when command bit15 is set; 0x6c080000 has immediate address zero.

Pinned PCSX2 Vif_Codes.cpp lines 674-685 sets CL to code low byte and WL to code byte 1 from STCYCL. Lines 708-717 sets mode from STMOD code & 3. Thus 0x01000404 sets CL=4/WL=4 and 0x05000000 sets mode=0.

001124c0.c and 0022fda8.c each set uGpffff9218=0 and uGpffff921c=0. Search of all 3837 saved generated function C files finds those names in eight functions: 001124c0, 00128e88, 00129bf8, 0021c3e0, 0021cc88, 0021ced0, 00228908, 0022fda8. The 001ce288 static direct-call closure includes 00128e88 but not the other seven.
